user.title: Connect to MikroTik router
user.description: Uses the RouterOS API (api-ssl on port 8729, or api on 8728). Run routeros/ha-setup.rsc on the router first.

data_description.host: IP address of the router (the CAPsMAN controller).
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off when the router uses a self-signed certificate.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default (8729 with SSL, 8728 without).

data_description.wan_interface: Gets traffic sensors and an on/off switch. Use pppoe-out1 or similar if your internet connection is PPPoE.
data_description.lan_interface: Gets traffic sensors only, usually the bridge.
data_description.switch_interfaces: Other interfaces to create on/off switches for. Wi-Fi networks get switches automatically. Never add the interface Home Assistant uses to reach the router.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to the router again

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check that the API service is enabled and allowed from Home Assistant's IP.

abort.not_loaded: The integration must be loaded (router reachable) to change options.
